items.title: Keep dog on a leash (max. 2 m) outside enclosed property
items.quote: ordne ich hiermit gemäß § 14 Abs. 1 OBG NRW an, dass Ihr Hund außerhalb Ihres befriedeten Besitztums ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine zu führen ist.
items.computation: The order takes effect "ab sofort" (immediately) as of the letter's date, 15.05.2025. This is an ongoing duty with no stated end date, so the due date given here is the day compliance must start, not a final day; the obligation continues until the order is lifted or successfully challenged.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 15.05.2025, posted by an authority → deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW): Mon 19.05.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period (§ 74 VwGO) starts the next day and would end Thu 19.06.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB), but that day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in NRW, so the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 20.06.2025 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG i.V.m. § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO, § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO).

warnings: The letter threatens a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of 250,00 € only if the leashing order is violated in the future — this is not a payment currently due, and no invoice or bank details for it are given.
The Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states "Ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt" — only a Klage (lawsuit) to the Verwaltungsgericht is available, not a Widerspruch.

The deemed-delivery date (19.05.2025) and thus the Klage deadline (20.06.2025) is an assumption based on the letter's printed date; if the person can show a later actual delivery date, the deadline could be later — confirm the envelope postmark if in doubt.
This is a deadline for filing a court action (Klage); get advice from a Verbraucherzentrale or a lawyer well before the deadline, as this tool cannot draft or file the lawsuit.
The IBAN printed in the footer (DE70 4405 0199 0001 0001 00) is well-formed and matches a German Sparkasse, but no payment is currently demanded in this letter, so there is no need to use it now.
